title: Stare Setup Guide redesign
brief: Redesign of the first-run Setup Guide (Sources/Stare/OnboardingView.swift; the real window is 460×430 points): a single Screen Recording permission with three states (denied, grantedPendingRestart, granted), one primary action per state, and 'Not now' always relegated. Modern 21st-inspired look at native-macOS restraint, drawn honestly as a real window with traffic lights and the title 'Stare'. The chosen artboard 03 is drawn at that real window size; 01 and 02 stay at 880×760 as alternative directions.

artboards.title: Status-led hero
artboards.tradeoff: One always-centered primary action that substitutes by state, with an inline 'what happens next' line — maximum focus, but the action's meaning shifts under the user between states

artboards.title: Two-step guide with footer action bar
artboards.tradeoff: Explains the flow first (what Stare does → permission) and pins actions in a macOS-style footer bar — most narrative, but taller hierarchy and a footer bar curling the window even for one remaining step

artboards.title: Permission checklist card
artboards.tradeoff: The permission is one task row with its action living inside the card and 'Not now' demoted to the window bottom — most task-like and compact, but the primary action changes position between states
